scope: Sanitised aggregate account of existing local start records, source snapshots and resume records; private training inputs and source archives are not distributed here
integrity_controls: The recorded training configuration contains the index SHA-256; a changed configuration or index prevents resuming that run.
Published-run mode rejects a resume when the source-code digest differs from the original start digest.
The input index and frame selection still matched all three recorded start hashes during this audit. Later database labels therefore do not change these indexed training samples.
limitations: The verification script checks consistency of the released aggregate records. It cannot independently hash private files that are not included.
The recorded digests do not provide a complete per-image checksum manifest for historical source pixels.
Source code, complete configurations, sampler state and raw training data are not provided by this package; full training reproduction remains unavailable.
No private paths, photo/video names, frame identifiers or held-out outcomes are included.
